text_block_list.text:
On our way back from an outing with Cheval 
Grand—

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
......U-Um. All that's left is to head 
home...... right......?

"Everything planned is done, and indeed, 
all that's left is to go home, but it's 
still only noon."
choice_data_list: If you'd like, wanna grab lunch together?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh...?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...U-Understood. If it's only for lunch...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list: What do you feel like eating?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-No, as for me... Whatever you'd like to 
eat, Trainer...

Cheval Grand seems restless. It looks like 
she still hasn't shaken off her nerves...

"Even so, it's important for a trainer to 
be someone they can consult about 
anything, so I'd really like to be someone 
she can rely on."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah... Smells nice...

Following Cheval Grand's gaze, I see a 
shop selling freshly steamed meat buns.
choice_data_list:
Alright, shall we have meat buns for 
lunch?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Eh, ah... N-No! I-It's not like I wanted 
to eat it or anything...!
choice_data_list: Now you're making me crave nikuman too!
Now you're making me crave nikuman too!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Mm, delicious...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I've never eaten anything like this. 
Usually, mine are much more plain, so..."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
There's lots of chashu pork in it too... 
It kind of feels a bit fancy...
choice_data_list:
I wish they sold it at convenience stores 
too.

I wish they sold it at convenience stores 
too.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...I... like convenience store ones too. 
Above all, they're convenient."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Just the other day, before I knew it, I'd 
eaten five of them. I'm supposed to cut 
back on snacking, but I couldn't help 
it...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
The staff were surprised too because I 
kept coming back so many times... Ah, 
hahaha...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...Ah! S-Sorry! Wh-What am I doing, 
talking to myself...?"

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
Thank you for the meal. It was 
delicious... truly.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Well then... um...

Cheval Grand radiated an aura of wanting 
to go home. However, seeing her look like 
she was enjoying herself, even for a 
moment, could definitely be called a 
success.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
“......I-I'm so sorry. Even though you 
went out of your way to invite me...”

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm gloomy... and I can't really talk 
about fun things... S-So from now on, it's 
totally okay if you don't go out of your 
way for me—
choice_data_list:
Next time, I'll find a place you can enjoy 
too!

Next time, I'll find a place you'll enjoy 
too!
Sorry I made you worry today.
Sorry for making you worry today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
I'm gloomy... and I can't really talk 
about fun things... S-So from now on, it's 
totally okay if you don't go out of your 
way for me—
choice_data_list:
Next time, I'll find a place you can enjoy 
too!

Next time, I'll find a place you'll enjoy 
too!
Sorry I made you worry today.
Sorry for making you worry today, huh?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... N-Next time? With me... again?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
choice_data_list:
Because I think it's something we both 
need, I guess?

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"I... see. If... it's necessary... ...Um, 
if the opportunity arises... again."

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
N-N-No! Y-You're the one who was being 
considerate, Trainer...!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text:
"...If only I weren't like this... I 
could've enjoyed my food so much more..."

There was a moment where she genuinely 
seemed to have fun—being able to share a 
time like that is something I should truly 
celebrate as her Trainer.

Of course, when it comes to supporting 
her, I shouldn't settle for our current 
relationship, but—
choice_data_list: Let's go grab lunch together next time!

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Huh... Ah...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: ...Y-Yes. If you say so, Trainer...
